prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Recovery Warning: Add a prominent warning hint on the sign-in screen urging users to log in with their original account to preserve existing pets. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in with a different account or signing in again.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Stage-Based Preset Pet Visualizer: Redesign the pet creation screen using a stage layout with instant high-quality previews of preset pet companions. (why: Adoption has a 60.9% drop-off rate and users reported issues where custom pet generation failed or looked wrong.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Permissions Setup Checklist: Display a explicit setup checklist during the waiting screen showing rendering progress and desktop display window verification. (why: 3 support tickets reported pets failing to show on the desktop or the app failing to open, while the waiting screen takes a median of 201s.)
3: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Pet Controls Tutorial: Insert a dedicated tutorial screen before completing onboarding that explicitly explains how to move, hide, and interact with the desktop pet. (why: Support received multiple complaints from users who found it unclear how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Clear Onboarding Duration Copy: Update the welcome story headline and body text to state that setting up a pet takes under two minutes. (why: The average time spent on choose_path is 514 seconds, indicating users abandon or idle without understanding how short setup is.)
5: [adoption, new_flow] Photo Quality Pre-Check Sub-Flow: Introduce a photo review screen that validates user photos for lighting and resolution before submitting for custom pet generation. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failing or resulting in broken models due to poor input photos.)
6: [home, notification] Desktop Ready System Notification Prompt: Configure the waiting screen to trigger a system desktop notification prompt when pet rendering finishes. (why: Mean time spent waiting is 2336s because users switch away from the app while waiting for pet generation.)

scores.note: Strong evidence from 8 support emails; simple copy/hint update to prevent account duplication.
Targets the largest drop-off step (adoption at 60.9%) backed by tickets, but requires significant UI redesign.
Addresses 201s median wait time and technical tickets with an in-place checklist UI.
High drop-off step (64.8%) supported by multiple control complaints, requires a new screen.
Cheap copy fix addressing 514s mean idle time on choose_path, though lacking direct support mail evidence.
Fixes custom generation errors at adoption, but adds an extra sub-flow screen friction.
High mean wait time (2336s) caused by context switching; OS prompt retains returning users effectively.
